name: littlecoder
description: A coding agent tuned for small local models, built on top of pi. Exposed via ttyd for browser-based terminal access.

notes.text: Access littlecoder in your browser at http://<container-ip>. The first run launches the interactive setup.
Config and session data is stored in ~/.config/little-coder/.
Browser access uses ttyd, which has no authentication by default. Restrict port 80 with a reverse proxy or firewall before exposing it publicly.
Requires a local LLM server running alongside littlecoder (e.g. llama.cpp on port 8888).
